name: Incline barbell press
notes: Incline barbell press, bench set around 30 degrees.

guide.setup: Lie back on a bench inclined around 30 degrees with feet planted, shoulder blades pulled together, and hands just wider than shoulder width.
guide.execution: Unrack over the shoulders, lower with control to the upper chest, then press up until the elbows lock.
guide.cues: Stay tight through the upper back. Keep wrists over elbows. Drive through the feet.
guide.mistakes: Setting the bench too steep; bouncing the bar; flaring elbows straight out; lifting the hips off the bench.
